visualRegions.description: Complete warm office atrium showing reception, open work floor, conference room, pantry and service core
Entrance lobby with curved reception desk, visitor seating, directory wall and planted atrium at the left
Open plan work floor with desks, monitors, chairs, plants and ceiling cable trays in the centre
Glass conference room with long table, chairs, presentation screen, whiteboard and camera
Break room kitchenette and pantry with coffee counter, refrigerator, sink, cabinets and dining table
Service core with elevator doors, stairwell, server racks, HVAC duct and fire panel at the right
